items.t: 4 S&P 500 Dividend Stocks Paying Shareholders More Than Their Free Cash Flow
items.sum: A fat yield looks like a gift until the cash behind it runs dry. Four household S&P 500 names are sending shareholders checks bigger than the money coming in, and one test shows which payouts may not survive.

items.t: New 3M™ Cooling Film helps fleet and rail operators keep cabin interiors cooler and improve efficiency
items.sum: 3M is launching 3M™ Cooling Film, a roof-applied heat-management solution designed to help keep vehicle cabins cooler, reduce cooling demand, and improve operational efficiency as heat challenges intensify across transportation environments.

items.t: 3M's Capital Distribution Strategy: Can It Sustain Higher Payouts?
items.sum: MMM's robust cash position, dividend hikes and aggressive share buybacks reinforce its shareholder rewards strategy. Can strong cash flow sustain higher payouts?

items.t: 3M sees scope for earnings growth as productivity gains and innovation gather pace, says UBS
items.sum: 3M Co (NYSE:MMM) has significant scope to expand profit margins and increase earnings through 2030, supported by manufacturing efficiencies, stronger pricing and a shift towards more customer-focused innovation, according to UBS, which maintained its 'buy' rating.
